findings.title: Cancelled talent timeout can detach a newer spec-switch watcher
findings.classification: Reproduced stale timer mutating a newer production watcher; native spec operation not performed
findings.trigger: Classic talent-group await A starts, is cancelled near its five-second deadline, then await B starts before A's uncancellable timeout fires
findings.observation: Old resolve(A) clears the shared specSwitchAwaitFrame now owned by B. B loses its native event observer and later times out; the top-level old completion generation guard cannot undo this earlier cleanup. Existing learn-state identity checks do reject cancelled learn callbacks, so not every timer assignment is a stale-write bug.
findings.proposal: Give each await its own identity/frame/timer closure. Cleanup must only retire resources it owns; cancellation must settle/invalidate the old closure even when After has no handle. Retain existing applyCancelGen and public callbacks.
findings.acceptance: Cancel A at 4.9s, begin B, fire A's 5s timeout, deliver B's event at 5.1s: B must keep its watcher and complete once. Test normal success, independent timeout, repeated cancel/replacement, absent timer fallback, and no new frame growth.
findings.status: OPEN; audit/proposals only; no new fix applied
findings.nativeStatus: NOT RUN: no native error/taint/FPS certification

findings.title: Portrait/threat callers calculate with potentially secret frame levels
findings.classification: Conditional secret FrameLevel getter contract failure; the audited native frames' aspect provenance is unknown
findings.trigger: A portrait/root/border GetFrameLevel returns an inaccessible value permitted by the modern/Forever FrameLevel aspect declaration.
findings.observation: Complete production portrait combat/normal and private threat-raise consumers hit five explicit opaque arithmetic traps. findings.proposal: Capture intended public levels at actual owned constructors and parent-level writers, then derive the existing offsets. Guard any native getter before arithmetic.
